reason: Since the installed release (e3682f8) neither the schema nor the model changed, so no stored type changed and no stored row is transformed. What the new release adds to stored data has existing shapes: two files of a session directory (executor.lock, which holds no content, and a refused.json the host writes for an integration, of the type that file already has), an Evidence artifact named candidate-paths with the list of paths a candidate changes, and text values of existing fields (blockers, evidence descriptions). The listing of attempts changed its order only.
